Halcyon Health

Offer of Employment

Dear Sam Rivera,

We are pleased to offer you the role of Staff Software Engineer at Halcyon Health. Halcyon Health is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: HLCN).

Position: Staff Software Engineer

Location: Remote (US)

Base Salary: $232,500 per year

Sign-on bonus: $25,000, payable within 30 days of your start date.

Annual bonus target: 20% of base salary.

Equity: 4,800 RSUs with an estimated grant value of $260,000, vesting quarterly over 4 years.

Relocation assistance: not applicable.

Paid time off: flexible (unlimited) PTO.

Your start date will be January 12, 2027.

This position is fully remote within the United States.
